description: Optimized I2V 바인딩 — Lightning LoRA + FBCache + RIFE. 기존 바인딩과 호환.

teacache_notes.threshold: 0.3 = conservative. Quality OK → try 0.4, 0.5 for more speed. Quality drop → remove TeaCache nodes.
teacache_notes.model_type: wan2.1_i2v_480p_14B works for Wan 2.2 MoE models
teacache_notes.risk: At 4 steps, TeaCache may be too aggressive. A/B test with same seed.

notes.seed_sync: node 20(HighNoise)과 21(LowNoise)의 seed를 동일하게 맞춰야 일관성 유지
notes.input_image: ComfyUI app/input/ 폴더에 이미지가 있어야 함
notes.lightning: Lightning LoRA Seko V1으로 4 steps (기존 20 대비 80% 감소). cfg 1.0, shift 5.0 필수. HighNoise/LowNoise 각각 별도 LoRA 파일.
notes.fbcache: threshold 0.12 (높을수록 빠르지만 품질 저하). 0.08-0.15 범위 권장.
notes.rife: x2 보간으로 16fps→32fps. 모션 부드러움 대폭 개선.

defaults.negative_prompt: (2D, sketch, illustration:1.5), different character, ugly, deformed, flat, cartoon, anime, photorealistic, glossy, plastic, smooth CGI, blurry, low resolution, multiple characters.
